<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the described carbonyl‑ene intramolecular reaction (ketone + alkene → cyclic alcohol, forming a C‑C bond and converting C=O to C‑O). We'll search the template catalog for templates that break a ketone and an alkene and form an alcohol and a C‑C bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C1CCCCC1C(=O)C=CC", 
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkene"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
